headline: East African Portland Cement full-year net profit declines 68.6%
summary: Kenya's East African Portland Cement reported a 68.6% drop in profit after tax to 1.58 billion Kenyan shillings for the financial year ending June 2026.
why: East African Portland Cement Company is a major manufacturer of construction materials in East Africa.

impacts.name: East African Portland Cement
impacts.why: A significant drop in net earnings decreases net profit margins and dividend capacity.
